caption: The drawing depicts a detailed sketch of a pitcher with a curvilinear spout and an ornate handle. The main image is centered within a large square and shows a side profile of the vessel. The pitcher has a wide, rounded body that tapers at the neck and base, sits on a small circular pedestal, and features a broad, outward-curving spout opposite a handle that is elaborately curved. The drawing uses shades of gray, likely pencil, on a beige or off-white background, with the primary objects filled in with shading to create a sense of depth and curvature. Below the main square, three smaller schematic views are rendered in simple outlines: the far left shows a top-down circular view with dimensions, the middle shows a front elevation with height marked, and the far right shows an isolated view of the handle profile with a measurement. The sheet is bordered with light lines defining the edges of the composition and the sections.
title: Pewter Creamer
